_comment: A7 compliance rules (S3 T8). Data, not code: app/compliance/filter.py reads this file once. The build plan says rules.yaml; PyYAML is not installed, so JSON. Matching is case-insensitive. kind: phrase (literal phrases, word boundaries, any whitespace between words, straight or curly apostrophes, hyphen or space in hyphenated words) | regex | requires (text must contain `pattern`). action: block | flag | rewrite (rewrite only for requires: appends `replacement`). allow: phrases that make a match inside them harmless. unless: a regex; when it occurs anywhere in the text the rule does not fire. The token {{disclaimer}} stands for the text of config/disclaimer.md.

rules.description: Promotional or advisory phrases: direct buy/sell advice, promises of gains, pressure to act.
Personalized instructions tied to the reader's own holdings ("sell your AAPL", "your portfolio should", "you need to buy").
Performance mentions must reference ledger data: allowed only when the text carries a {{ledger:...}} reference (rendered by T12). Flag, not block, until T12 exists.
The research disclaimer (config/disclaimer.md) must be present; if it is missing it is appended. The only rewrite.
